extracted text: The study investigates the effect of minor Sc additions on AA8090 aluminum-lithium alloy. The alloys were homogenized at 540°C for 40h, forged at 500°C to 50mm thickness, solution treated at 540°C for 1-2h, cold water quenched, 2-3% stretched, and artificially aged at 170°C for 24h (T8 temper). All alloys contained approximately 0.015-0.02% Ti. The Vickers hardness was measured using 5kg load. Sc additions ≥0.43% resulted in significant grain refinement.
